inventory.unit_ids: v04-u000001 through v04-u002421, source order, no semantic merges
inventory.word_count_definition: sum(len(unit.text.split())); note labels are included; inline HTML superscripts remain joined to their words; page labels and digital controls/notices are excluded.
inventory.language_note: The French edition includes original English letters and a parallel English/French press excerpt. Both languages are preserved, so the word count is not exclusively French.
inventory.note_frame_voice: Explicit signatures identify note framing; embedded document voices and unsigned subsequent biographies are not subsumed by that signature.
inventory.source_note: Stable source-order identifiers preserve the saved Gutenberg text. Historical document and note-frame distinctions are retained in the unit metadata.

verification.coverage_scope: Every nonblank text node in the downloaded official HTML belongs to a retained unit, preserved digital exclusion, page marker or Gutenberg boilerplate. No claim that Gutenberg captured every printed element of the 1891 edition.

parser_environment.line_endings: Official files retain CRLF bytes; this libxml2 parser retains CR in DOM text and lxml serialization renders it as . Newer libxml2 may normalize CRLF to LF; stored source_html hashes are defined by this recorded parser and serialization.

limitations: No complete collation with the printed 1891 facsimile; completeness refers to the downloaded Gutenberg HTML.
Gutenberg credits BnF/Gallica images but supplies no verified Gallica ARK here.
The collected NOTES heading and relocation of footnotes are digital presentation; original pagination of note text is not asserted.
Voice classification is conservative, structural and partly unresolved; embedded quotes can coexist with the frame voice.
The retained original title-page rights notice is historical text; it is not a claim of current copyright.
Legacy-named files are the current official files-route source, revised in 2021, not certified original 2010 release bytes.
HTML/TXT alternate renditions are not asserted identical; observed differences are recorded in source-variants.json.
Both original English documents and French translations are retained; neither replaces the other.
Conservative body voice labels intentionally avoid attributing memoir narration to the last correspondence heading.
rights_scope: Project Gutenberg identifies public-domain status in the USA. No separate worldwide copyright clearance is asserted.
